pages.text: The Disk Manipulator is a specialized block that transfers items and fluids between storage disks and your Refined Storage network. It can operate in three modes: insert (moving items from the network to disks), extract (moving items from disks to the network), or both simultaneously. This component is particularly useful for managing offline storage, backing up specific resources, or transferring items between separate networks.

The Disk Manipulator has slots for up to 9 storage disks of any type. Its filtering system allows precise control over which items are transferred, supporting whitelist/blacklist configuration and NBT/metadata matching. When combined with redstone control, the Disk Manipulator can be automated to perform scheduled backups or conditional transfers based on network states. Speed upgrades can significantly enhance transfer rates for large operations.
